art_instructions: Inside the cozy family_house living room, set a medium, eye-level scene with warm daylight from a low window with cream curtains at the back left and a small potted fern on a low wooden table. On the left foreground, the Owl perches on a short wooden stool, chibi-cute with round amber eyes, mottled brown-and-cream feathers, a small green scarf, and a tiny satchel; she extends one wing forward offering a single bright pink daisy-like flower with a yellow center toward the Dinosaur. On the right foreground, the small green Dinosaur (pea‑green with a pale mint belly and tiny dorsal nubs) stands facing her, arms reaching out with stubby fingers to receive the flower, mouth forming a hopeful, soft smile and eyes bright. Keep the exchange centered between them so the one flower is the clear focal point; if desired, let a second flower peek subtly from the Owl’s satchel pocket to hint she had more earlier without distracting from the single gift in her wing. Place a soft green floor cushion near the low table and a woven basket under it to echo earlier rooms, keeping shapes simple and pastel. Maintain Korean aegyo style: 2–3 heads tall, rounded silhouettes, minimal cel-shading, clean monoline strokes, and gentle, airy background. Ensure both characters fill most of the frame width, with open, friendly poses and readable hands/wing around the flower.
